visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with an extreme close-up of a woman's forehead showing deep horizontal expression lines, with a red "before" overlay, followed by an "after" shot showing smoother skin. It then cuts to a woman's back and shoulders before introducing the main host, a woman with short brown hair wearing a blue and white striped shirt. She speaks enthusiastically to the camera in an indoor setting with brightly lit floral wallpaper and a blurred city view through a window in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a medical aesthetic clinic where the host is seen with a patient wearing glasses. The host points to the patient's forehead wrinkles while a medical assistant in a light blue uniform cleans the skin. The host is then shown draped in plastic wrap over her shoulders, appearing to wait for a trapezius muscle treatment. (3) Dr. Shen, a male doctor in a white lab coat and blue surgical mask, examines the patient and host. He is shown administering injections into the forehead of the patient and the shoulders of the host. The video utilizes various text overlays to emphasize key points, ending with the host returning to her original indoor setting to conclude the vlog with expressive hand gestures and a smile.
